```{=html}
<style id="deck-stage-print-page"> that connectedCallback injects
       into <head> (the @page at-rule has no effect inside shadow DOM). */
    @media print {
      :host {
        position: static;
        inset: auto;
        background: none;
        overflow: visible;
        color: inherit;
      }
      .stage { position: static; display: block; }
      .canvas {
        transform: none !important;
        width: auto !important;
        height: auto !important;
        background: none;
        will-change: auto;
      }
      ::slotted(*) {
        position: relative !important;
        inset: auto !important;
        width: var(--deck-design-w) !important;
        height: var(--deck-design-h) !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
        pointer-events: auto;
        break-after: page;
        page-break-after: always;
        break-inside: avoid;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      ::slotted(*:last-child) {
        break-after: auto;
        page-break-after: auto;
      }
      .overlay, .tapzones { display: none !important; }
    }
  `;

  class DeckStage extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ['width', 'height', 'noscale']; }

    constructor() {
      super();
      this._root = this.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
      this._index = 0;
      this._slides = [];
      this._notes = [];
      this._hideTimer = null;
      this._mouseIdleTimer = null;
      this._storageKey = STORAGE_PREFIX + (location.pathname || '/');

      this._onKey = this._onKey.bind(this);
      this._onResize = this._onResize.bind(this);
      this._onSlotChange = this._onSlotChange.bind(this);
      this._onMouseMove = this._onMouseMove.bind(this);
      this._onTapBack = this._onTapBack.bind(this);
      this._onTapForward = this._onTapForward.bind(this);
    }

    get designWidth() {
      return parseInt(this.getAttribute('width'), 10) || DESIGN_W_DEFAULT;
    }
    get designHeight() {
      return parseInt(this.getAttribute('height'), 10) || DESIGN_H_DEFAULT;
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      this._render();
      this._loadNotes();
      this._syncPrintPageRule();
      window.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKey);
      window.addEventListener('resize', this._onResize);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', this._onMouseMove, { passive: true });
      // Initial collection + layout happens via slotchange, which fires on mount.
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKey);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', this._onResize);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', this._onMouseMove);
      if (this._hideTimer) clearTimeout(this._hideTimer);
      if (this._mouseIdleTimer) clearTimeout(this._mouseIdleTimer);
    }

    attributeChangedCallback() {
      if (this._canvas) {
        this._canvas.style.width = this.designWidth + 'px';
        this._canvas.style.height = this.designHeight + 'px';
        this._canvas.style.setProperty('--deck-design-w', this.designWidth + 'px');
        this._canvas.style.setProperty('--deck-design-h', this.designHeight + 'px');
        this._fit();
        this._syncPrintPageRule();
      }
    }

    _render() {
      const style = document.createElement('style');
      style.textContent = stylesheet;

      const stage = document.createElement('div');
      stage.className = 'stage';

      const canvas = document.createElement('div');
      canvas.className = 'canvas';
      canvas.style.width = this.designWidth + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = this.designHeight + 'px';
      canvas.style.setProperty('--deck-design-w', this.designWidth + 'px');
      canvas.style.setProperty('--deck-design-h', this.designHeight + 'px');

      const slot = document.createElement('slot');
      slot.addEventListener('slotchange', this._onSlotChange);
      canvas.appendChild(slot);
      stage.appendChild(canvas);

      // Tap zones (mobile): left third = back, right third = forward.
      const tapzones = document.createElement('div');
      tapzones.className = 'tapzones export-hidden';
      tapzones.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      const tzBack = document.createElement('div');
      tzBack.className = 'tapzone tapzone--back';
      const tzMid = document.createElement('div');
      tzMid.className = 'tapzone tapzone--mid';
      tzMid.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      const tzFwd = document.createElement('div');
      tzFwd.className = 'tapzone tapzone--fwd';
      tzBack.addEventListener('click', this._onTapBack);
      tzFwd.addEventListener('click', this._onTapForward);
      tapzones.append(tzBack, tzMid, tzFwd);

      // Overlay: compact, solid black, with clickable controls.
      const overlay = document.createElement('div');
      overlay.className = 'overlay export-hidden';
      overlay.setAttribute('role', 'toolbar');
      overlay.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Deck controls');
      overlay.innerHTML = `
        <button class="btn prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous slide" title="Previous (←)">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3L5 8l5 5"/></svg>
        </button>
        <span class="count" aria-live="polite"><span class="current">1</span><span class="sep">/</span><span class="total">1</span></span>
        <button class="btn next" type="button" aria-label="Next slide" title="Next (→)">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3l5 5-5 5"/></svg>
        </button>
        <span class="divider"></span>
        <button class="btn reset" type="button" aria-label="Reset to first slide" title="Reset (R)">Reset<span class="kbd">R</span></button>
      `;

      overlay.querySelector('.prev').addEventListener('click', () => this._go(this._index - 1, 'click'));
      overlay.querySelector('.next').addEventListener('click', () => this._go(this._index + 1, 'click'));
      overlay.querySelector('.reset').addEventListener('click', () => this._go(0, 'click'));

      this._root.append(style, stage, tapzones, overlay);
      this._canvas = canvas;
      this._slot = slot;
      this._overlay = overlay;
      this._countEl = overlay.querySelector('.current');
      this._totalEl = overlay.querySelector('.total');
    }

    /** @page must live in the document stylesheet — it's a no-op inside
     *  shadow DOM. Inject/update a single <head> style tag so the print
     *  sheet matches the design size and Save-as-PDF yields one slide per
     *  page with no margins. */
    _syncPrintPageRule() {
      const id = 'deck-stage-print-page';
      let tag = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!tag) {
        tag = document.createElement('style');
        tag.id = id;
        document.head.appendChild(tag);
      }
      tag.textContent =
        '@page { size: ' + this.designWidth + 'px ' + this.designHeight + 'px; margin: 0; } ' +
        '@media print { html, body { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; background: none !important; overflow: visible !important; height: auto !important; } ' +
        '* { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; } }';
    }

    _onSlotChange() {
      this._collectSlides();
      this._restoreIndex();
      this._applyIndex({ showOverlay: false, broadcast: true, reason: 'init' });
      this._fit();
    }

    _collectSlides() {
      const assigned = this._slot.assignedElements({ flatten: true });
      this._slides = assigned.filter((el) => {
        // Skip template/style/script nodes even if someone slots them.
        const tag = el.tagName;
        return tag !== 'TEMPLATE' && tag !== 'SCRIPT' && tag !== 'STYLE';
      });

      this._slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
        const n = i + 1;
        // Determine a label for comment flow: prefer explicit data-label,
        // then an existing data-screen-label, then first heading, else "Slide".
        let label = slide.getAttribute('data-label');
        if (!label) {
          const existing = slide.getAttribute('data-screen-label');
          if (existing) {
            // Strip any leading number the author may have included.
            label = existing.replace(/^\s*\d+\s*/, '').trim() || existing;
          }
        }
        if (!label) {
          const h = slide.querySelector('h1, h2, h3, [data-title]');
          if (h) label = (h.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 40);
        }
        if (!label) label = 'Slide';
        slide.setAttribute('data-screen-label', `${pad2(n)} ${label}`);

        // Validation attribute for comment flow / auto-checks.
        if (!slide.hasAttribute('data-om-validate')) {
          slide.setAttribute('data-om-validate', VALIDATE_ATTR);
        }

        slide.setAttribute('data-deck-slide', String(i));
      });

      if (this._totalEl) this._totalEl.textContent = String(this._slides.length || 1);
      if (this._index >= this._slides.length) this._index = Math.max(0, this._slides.length - 1);
    }

    _loadNotes() {
      const tag = document.getElementById('speaker-notes');
      if (!tag) { this._notes = []; return; }
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(tag.textContent || '[]');
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) this._notes = parsed;
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[deck-stage] Failed to parse #speaker-notes JSON:', e);
        this._notes = [];
      }
    }

    _restoreIndex() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(this._storageKey);
        if (raw != null) {
          const n = parseInt(raw, 10);
          if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n < this._slides.length) {
            this._index = n;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }

    _persistIndex() {
      try { localStorage.setItem(this._storageKey, String(this._index)); }
      catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }

    _applyIndex({ showOverlay = true, broadcast = true, reason = 'init' } = {}) {
      if (!this._slides.length) return;
      const prev = this._prevIndex == null ? -1 : this._prevIndex;
      const curr = this._index;
      this._slides.forEach((s, i) => {
        if (i === curr) s.setAttribute('data-deck-active', '');
        else s.removeAttribute('data-deck-active');
      });
      if (this._countEl) this._countEl.textContent = String(curr + 1);
      this._persistIndex();

      if (broadcast) {
        // (1) Legacy: host-window postMessage for speaker-notes renderers.
        try { window.postMessage({ slideIndexChanged: curr }, '*'); } catch (e) {}

        // (2) In-page CustomEvent on the <deck-stage> element itself.
        //     Bubbles and composes out of shadow DOM so slide code can listen:
        //       document.querySelector('deck-stage').addEventListener('slidechange', e => {
        //         e.detail.index, e.detail.previousIndex, e.detail.total, e.detail.slide, e.detail.reason
        //       });
        const detail = {
          index: curr,
          previousIndex: prev,
          total: this._slides.length,
          slide: this._slides[curr] || null,
          previousSlide: prev >= 0 ? (this._slides[prev] || null) : null,
          reason: reason, // 'init' | 'keyboard' | 'click' | 'tap' | 'api'
        };
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('slidechange', {
          detail,
          bubbles: true,
          composed: true,
        }));
      }

      this._prevIndex = curr;
      if (showOverlay) this._flashOverlay();
    }

    _flashOverlay() {
      if (!this._overlay) return;
      this._overlay.setAttribute('data-visible', '');
      if (this._hideTimer) clearTimeout(this._hideTimer);
      this._hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._overlay.removeAttribute('data-visible');
      }, OVERLAY_HIDE_MS);
    }

    _fit() {
      if (!this._canvas) return;
      // PPTX export sets noscale so the DOM capture sees authored-size
      // geometry — the scaled canvas is in shadow DOM, so the exporter's
      // resetTransformSelector can't reach .canvas.style.transform directly.
      if (this.hasAttribute('noscale')) {
        this._canvas.style.transform = 'none';
        return;
      }
      const vw = window.innerWidth;
      const vh = window.innerHeight;
      const s = Math.min(vw / this.designWidth, vh / this.designHeight);
      this._canvas.style.transform = `scale(${s})`;
    }

    _onResize() { this._fit(); }

    _onMouseMove() {
      // Keep overlay visible while mouse moves; hide after idle.
      this._flashOverlay();
    }

    _onTapBack(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._go(this._index - 1, 'tap');
    }

    _onTapForward(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._go(this._index + 1, 'tap');
    }

    _onKey(e) {
      // Ignore when the user is typing.
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && (t.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName))) return;
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;

      const key = e.key;
      let handled = true;

      if (key === 'ArrowRight' || key === 'PageDown' || key === ' ' || key === 'Spacebar') {
        this._go(this._index + 1, 'keyboard');
      } else if (key === 'ArrowLeft' || key === 'PageUp') {
        this._go(this._index - 1, 'keyboard');
      } else if (key === 'Home') {
        this._go(0, 'keyboard');
      } else if (key === 'End') {
        this._go(this._slides.length - 1, 'keyboard');
      } else if (key === 'r' || key === 'R') {
        this._go(0, 'keyboard');
      } else if (/^[0-9]$/.test(key)) {
        // 1..9 jump to that slide; 0 jumps to 10.
        const n = key === '0' ? 9 : parseInt(key, 10) - 1;
        if (n < this._slides.length) this._go(n, 'keyboard');
      } else {
        handled = false;
      }

      if (handled) {
        e.preventDefault();
        this._flashOverlay();
      }
    }

    _go(i, reason = 'api') {
      if (!this._slides.length) return;
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(this._slides.length - 1, i));
      if (clamped === this._index) {
        this._flashOverlay();
        return;
      }
      this._index = clamped;
      this._applyIndex({ showOverlay: true, broadcast: true, reason });
    }

    // Public API ------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Current slide index (0-based). */
    get index() { return this._index; }
    /** Total slide count. */
    get length() { return this._slides.length; }
    /** Programmatically navigate. */
    goTo(i) { this._go(i, 'api'); }
    next() { this._go(this._index + 1, 'api'); }
    prev() { this._go(this._index - 1, 'api'); }
    reset() { this._go(0, 'api'); }
  }

  if (!customElements.get('deck-stage')) {
    customElements.define('deck-stage', DeckStage);
  }
})();

</script>
<template id="__bundler_thumbnail" data-bg-color="#0d1b2e">

    <rect x="100" y="540" width="160" height="16" rx="4" fill="white" opacity="0.3"/>

</template>

<script type="application/json" id="speaker-notes">
[
  "Welcome everyone. Today we're going to get under the hood of ActivitySim, specifically the initialization and accessibility components. These are the very first things that run when you kick off a model, and understanding them is foundational to everything that comes after. Whether you're debugging a run or customizing ActivitySim for your region, this is where it all begins.",

  "Let's start with some context for those of you coming from the 4-step world. In the 4-step model, we think of travel as aggregate flows — zone to zone, period to period. ActivitySim flips this. Instead of flows, we simulate individual people making decisions throughout their day. Each synthetic person has a household, a set of possible activities, and a travel pattern. This shift from aggregate to disaggregate is the core conceptual leap.",

  "Here's the full ActivitySim pipeline at a glance. Don't worry about memorizing all the components — the key thing to notice is the structure. There's a startup phase where data is loaded and checked. Then a brief aggregate phase — this is where accessibility is computed. Then a long disaggregate phase where every behavioral model runs, person by person. Today we're focused on everything before that disaggregate phase begins.",

  "So what does initialization actually do? It's not really a model in the behavioral sense — it doesn't predict anything. Think of it as the setup crew before the main event. There are four distinct steps: loading land use data, loading and annotating household and person records, loading network level-of-service data — the skims — and pre-loading tour structures. Each of these prepares the data pipeline for the behavioral models downstream.",

  "Initialize Land Use is the very first step. It reads your zonal land use file — things like total employment, retail employment, population — and registers it as a named table in the pipeline. One important thing: ActivitySim uses lazy loading, so the table isn't actually read until something needs it. But by registering it here, we ensure consistent random seed behavior throughout the run.",

  "Now let's talk about the inject system, which is the machinery behind Initialize Households. ActivitySim uses a dependency injection pattern. When initialize_households runs, it asks for the persons table. The persons table requires the households table. The households table reads from your CSV input. This chain of dependencies is resolved automatically — you declare what you need, and the system figures out the order. This lazy loading approach also enables the model to be resumed mid-run after a crash.",

  "Initialize LOS handles your skims — the level-of-service matrices that encode travel times and costs between zones. Depending on your zone system, this varies considerably. In a one-zone TAZ model, you load highway and transit skim OMX files. In a two-zone system, you also load MAZ-to-MAZ walk and bike tables. The three-zone system adds TAP-to-TAP transit skims and the Transit Virtual Path Builder, which pre-computes transit path utilities. The TVPB step can be computationally expensive, so caching is available.",

  "Initialize Tours is a lighter step. For implementations that pre-define tour structures — such as mandatory work and school tours — this step reads those records into the pipeline before the behavioral models start allocating time windows and scheduling. It ensures that the tour table exists with the right structure so downstream models can annotate it consistently.",

  "The Input Checker is an optional but highly recommended step that runs before everything else. It uses the Pandera library to validate your input data against user-defined rules. You write Python code that checks column types, value ranges, referential integrity — whatever matters for your implementation. If any check fails, ActivitySim stops immediately with a clear log message rather than crashing mysteriously later. Think of it as your data contract.",

  "Now let's shift to Accessibility. This is a concept most of you know from the 4-step world, but in ActivitySim it's made explicit as a pre-computed zonal measure. The question accessibility answers is: from this zone, how easy is it to reach employment opportunities? The answer depends on how much employment exists nearby, and how difficult it is to reach — measured by travel time decay. Zones with lots of nearby jobs are highly accessible; zones surrounded by only distant jobs are not.",

  "Here's the math. For each origin zone i, accessibility is the log-sum of employment at each destination j, weighted by a decay function of travel time. The decay function is exponential — jobs that are farther away contribute less to accessibility. Walk access uses a very steep decay, meaning only very close jobs count. Auto access uses a shallower decay. Three time periods are used: AM peak, midday, and PM peak. The logarithm at the end compresses the distribution so that very high employment concentrations don't dominate.",

  "Let's look at the inputs and outputs concretely. Inputs: highway skims for three time periods with drive-alone toll time, transit skims with in-vehicle time, wait times, and walk access/egress, and your land use file with total and retail employment. Outputs: ten accessibility measures per zone — auto and transit for peak and off-peak, non-motorized, each split between retail and total employment. These become columns in your accessibility table, one row per TAZ.",

  "Here's the critical insight about where accessibility sits in the pipeline. It runs immediately after Initialize Land Use — before households and persons are even loaded. This is intentional. Accessibility is an aggregate, zone-level calculation. It doesn't need person records. Once computed, these ten measures are attached to the land use table and become available as explanatory variables in the behavioral models: school location choice, work location choice, destination choice for non-mandatory tours. Accessibility is a bridge between the network and individual decision-making.",

  "Let me summarize what we've covered. Initialization is the data pipeline setup — four steps that load, validate, and annotate your inputs before any behavior is modeled. The inject system enables lazy loading and makes the pipeline restartable. Accessibility is an aggregate, zone-level calculation that sits at the boundary between network data and behavioral modeling — it translates travel time skims into a measure that individuals can respond to. In our next session we'll start looking at the behavioral models that consume these outputs. Questions?",

  "Now let's go deeper on a question that trips up even experienced modelers: what number actually gets used when a submodel like auto ownership needs to represent accessibility? In a 4-step model, each submodel picks its own shortcut — the gravity model uses raw travel time, auto ownership uses time-savings-over-transit, mode choice uses IVT. These ad hoc measures were chosen because they fit the observed data well — not because they're theoretically consistent with each other. ActivitySim faces the same choice: you can feed auto ownership an aggregate zone-level measure, or you can use a disaggregate logsum derived from the mode choice model. The choice has major consequences when a policy changes time and cost in opposite directions.",

  "Here's the canonical example from WFRC — the Wasatch Front Regional Council in Salt Lake City. They test a downtown cordon toll. The toll makes driving into downtown faster because it reduces congestion — but it also costs money. The auto ownership model uses ad hoc accessibility: auto time savings versus transit. When you run the model, it sees the time saving and predicts more people will own cars. But that's wrong — a toll should be a deterrent. The model never sees the cost because cost was never included in the accessibility measure. Use the sliders to explore this — set both toll cost and time saving, and watch what the ad hoc model predicts. Then set toll cost only, with no time saving, and see how the model goes silent on the cost entirely.",

  "The logsum is the theoretically consistent alternative. It falls directly out of the mathematics of your mode choice model — you don't add anything new. If your mode choice utility for driving is beta-time times travel time plus beta-cost times travel cost, then the logsum is just the log of the sum of exponentiated utilities across all modes. Cost is already in there. When you add a toll, V-auto drops, the logsum drops, and the auto ownership model predicts less car ownership — all automatically, all from one consistent specification. Use the calculator on the right to explore: add a cordon toll and watch V-auto and the logsum respond. Notice how transit becomes relatively more attractive as auto cost rises.",

  "Now the honest part — and this is what separates good modeling presentations from great ones. The pros of disaggregate accessibility are real: consistent policy responses, automatic improvement as mode choice improves, and a rigorous consumer surplus measure for benefit-cost analysis. But the cons are equally real. First, computing logsums per person is expensive. Second — and this is critical — adding the disaggregate step is only half the job. You then have to retrofit every submodel that currently uses an ad hoc measure. That's expensive and tedious. And third, the most uncomfortable truth: ad hoc measures like time savings may simply predict car ownership better than the logsum does. Theoretical elegance does not guarantee better fit. Strategy A and Strategy B are both legitimate — the choice depends on your policy environment and team capacity.",

  "To wrap up: we've covered the full initialization pipeline and now a deep dive on the three types of accessibility measures. Aggregate accessibility is the log-sum-of-employment pre-computed per zone — fast, simple, and feeds long-term decisions. Disaggregate accessibility uses mode choice logsums per person — consistent and theoretically sound, but expensive and hard to retrofit. Ad hoc measures are the pragmatic middle ground — chosen for fit, not consistency, but vulnerable to novel policies like cordon tolls. Understanding where each type is used in your model — and where it might break — is foundational knowledge for any ActivitySim practitioner."
]
</script>

<style>
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --navy:       #0d1b2e;
  --navy-mid:   #152438;
  --navy-light: #1e3450;
  --teal:       oklch(0.60 0.13 196);
  --teal-lt:    oklch(0.95 0.04 196);
  --amber:      oklch(0.68 0.14 72);
  --amber-lt:   oklch(0.97 0.04 72);
  --off-white:  #f4f3ef;
  --white:      #ffffff;
  --text:       #1a2b3c;
  --muted:      #5a6e80;
  --border:     rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  --font:       'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  --mono:       'DM Mono', monospace;
}

section {
  font-family: var(--font);
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--off-white);
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Animation keyframes ── */
@keyframes fadeUp   { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(28px) } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) } }
@keyframes fadeIn   { from { opacity:0 } to { opacity:1 } }
@keyframes scaleIn  { from { opacity:0; transform:scale(0.88) } to { opacity:1; transform:scale(1) } }
@keyframes slideR   { from { opacity:0; transform:translateX(-24px) } to { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0) } }
@keyframes growW    { from { width:0 } to { width:100% } }
@keyframes drawPath { from { stroke-dashoffset:2000 } to { stroke-dashoffset:0 } }
@keyframes popIn    { from { opacity:0; transform:scale(0.6) } to { opacity:1; transform:scale(1) } }
@keyframes fillBar  { from { height:0 } to { height:var(--h) } }
@keyframes pulse    { 0%,100% { opacity:1 } 50% { opacity:0.5 } }

/* Stagger helpers — every animated el gets .an + .dN */
.an { animation-fill-mode: both; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); }
.an.fu { animation-name: fadeUp;  animation-duration: 0.55s; }
.an.fi { animation-name: fadeIn;  animation-duration: 0.45s; }
.an.si { animation-name: scaleIn; animation-duration: 0.45s; }
.an.sr { animation-name: slideR;  animation-duration: 0.45s; }

.d0 { animation-delay: 0.05s }
.d1 { animation-delay: 0.15s }
.d2 { animation-delay: 0.28s }
.d3 { animation-delay: 0.42s }
.d4 { animation-delay: 0.56s }
.d5 { animation-delay: 0.70s }
.d6 { animation-delay: 0.84s }
.d7 { animation-delay: 0.98s }
.d8 { animation-delay: 1.12s }
.d9 { animation-delay: 1.26s }

/* Paused when slide not active — re-triggered via JS on slidechange */
section:not([data-deck-active]) .an { animation-play-state: paused !important; }

/* ── Shared components ── */
.eyebrow {
  font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.eyebrow.amber { color: var(--amber); }
.slide-title {
  font-size: 68px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.08;
  color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 48px;
}
.slide-title.white { color: #fff; }

.card {
  background: #fff; border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.tag {
  display: inline-block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 100px; width: fit-content;
}
.tag.teal { background: var(--teal-lt); color: var(--teal); }
.tag.amber { background: var(--amber-lt); color: var(--amber); }
.tag.navy { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }

.mono { font-family: var(--mono); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 1 — TITLE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s1 {
  background: var(--navy);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 150px; position: relative;
}
.s1::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; right:-120px; top:-180px;
  width:780px; height:780px; border-radius:50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(0.45 0.13 196 / 0.4) 0%, transparent 65%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.s1::after {
  content:''; position:absolute; left:-60px; bottom:-120px;
  width:540px; height:540px; border-radius:50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(0.55 0.12 72 / 0.25) 0%, transparent 65%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.s1 .eyebrow { color: oklch(0.72 0.12 196); font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.s1 h1 {
  font-size: 96px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.0;
  color: #fff; max-width: 1000px; margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.s1 h1 em { color: oklch(0.72 0.13 196); font-style: normal; }
.s1 .subtitle {
  font-size: 34px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); max-width: 760px;
}
.s1 .meta {
  position: absolute; bottom: 64px; left: 150px; right: 150px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); padding-top: 24px;
}
.s1 .meta-chip {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
}
.s1 .meta-chip span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-weight: 500; }
.s1 .meta-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 2 — 4-STEP vs ABM
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s2 { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:72px 120px; }
.compare-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 60px 1fr;
  gap: 0; flex: 1; align-items: stretch;
}
.compare-col {
  background: #fff; border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 40px 44px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}
.compare-col.dark {
  background: var(--navy); color: #fff;
}
.compare-col h3 { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--navy); }
.compare-col.dark h3 { color: oklch(0.72 0.13 196); }
.compare-col .compare-item {
  display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;
}
.compare-col .ci-bullet {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--teal); margin-top: 13px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.compare-col.dark .ci-bullet { background: oklch(0.65 0.13 196); }
.compare-col .compare-item p { font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--muted); }
.compare-col.dark .compare-item p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }
.compare-arrow {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 36px; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 300;
}
.compare-note {
  margin-top: 24px; padding: 22px 32px; background: var(--teal-lt);
  border-radius: 12px; font-size: 24px; color: var(--navy); line-height: 1.5;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--teal);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 3 — PIPELINE OVERVIEW
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s3 {
  background: var(--navy); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 64px 120px; color: #fff;
}
.s3 .slide-title { margin-bottom: 36px; }
.pipeline-phases {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px; flex: 1;
}
.phase { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.phase-header {
  font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid; margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.phase-header.ph-teal { color: var(--teal); border-color: var(--teal); }
.phase-header.ph-amber { color: oklch(0.72 0.14 72); border-color: oklch(0.72 0.14 72); }
.phase-header.ph-white { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

.pbox {
  padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.3; border: 1px solid; font-weight: 500;
  position: relative;
}
.pbox.dim {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
}
.pbox.p-teal {
  background: oklch(0.3 0.1 196 / 0.5);
  border-color: var(--teal);
  color: #fff;
}
.pbox.p-amber {
  background: oklch(0.4 0.1 72 / 0.45);
  border-color: oklch(0.72 0.14 72);
  color: #fff;
}
.pbox.p-focus {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
}
.pbox .pbadge {
  position: absolute; top: -8px; right: 12px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
}
.pbox .pbadge.bt { background: var(--teal); color: #fff; }
.pbox .pbadge.ba { background: oklch(0.72 0.14 72); color: #fff; }

.phase-today {
  margin-top: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center;
  background: oklch(0.72 0.14 72 / 0.15);
  color: oklch(0.72 0.14 72);
  border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.14 72 / 0.3);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 4 — INIT OVERVIEW
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s4 { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:72px 120px; }
.init-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px; flex: 1;
}
.init-card {
  background: #fff; border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 32px 36px;
  display: flex; gap: 20px; align-items: flex-start;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--teal);
}
.init-card.amber { border-left-color: var(--amber); }
.init-card .ic-num {
  font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;
  color: var(--teal); opacity: 0.22; flex-shrink: 0;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.init-card.amber .ic-num { color: var(--amber); }
.init-card h3 { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.init-card p  { font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }
.init-note {
  background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px 36px; font-size: 23px;
  line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 16px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.init-note strong { color: oklch(0.72 0.13 196); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 5 — LAND USE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s5 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:60px; }
.s5 .left  { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.s5 .right { width:620px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; justify-content:center; }
.s5 .body-text { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 28px; }
.s5 .body-text strong { color: var(--navy); }

.yaml-block {
  background: var(--navy); border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 24px 28px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.7; overflow: hidden;
}
.yaml-block .yk { color: oklch(0.72 0.13 196); }
.yaml-block .yv { color: oklch(0.78 0.13 72); }
.yaml-block .yc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
.yaml-block .ys { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

.dt { background:#fff; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); }
.dt-head {
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff; padding:14px 24px;
  font-size:17px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase;
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:80px 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:12px;
}
.dt-row {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:80px 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  padding:12px 24px; gap:12px; font-size:19px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  font-family:var(--mono);
}
.dt-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.dt-row .zone { font-weight:700; color:var(--teal); }
.dt-row .val  { color:var(--muted); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 6 — INJECT / LAZY LOADING
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s6 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:60px; }
.s6 .left  { width:540px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.s6 .right { flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.s6 .body-text { font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 24px; }
.s6 .body-text strong { color: var(--navy); }
.inject-tree {
  width: 100%; max-width: 680px;
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 19px;
}
.it-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0;
  padding: 10px 0;
}
.it-indent { flex-shrink:0; }
.it-connector { flex-shrink:0; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
.it-box {
  padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3;
  border: 1px solid; flex: 1;
}
.it-box.root { background:oklch(0.3 0.1 196/0.5); border-color:var(--teal); color:#fff; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; }
.it-box.dep1 { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
.it-box.dep2 { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }
.it-box.leaf { background:oklch(0.4 0.1 72/0.4); border-color:oklch(0.72 0.14 72); color:#fff; }
.it-label {
  font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.07em;
  text-transform:uppercase; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px;
  margin-left:10px; flex-shrink:0;
}
.it-label.lt { background:var(--teal-lt); color:var(--teal); }
.it-label.la { background:var(--amber-lt); color:var(--amber); }
.inject-bg {
  background: var(--navy); border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 28px 24px; width:100%;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 7 — INIT LOS / SKIMS
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s7 {
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:72px 120px;
}
.s7 .slide-title { margin-bottom: 36px; }
.los-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:20px; flex:1; }
.los-card {
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:14px;
  padding:32px 28px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
.los-card h3 { font-size:24px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:16px; }
.los-card h3.teal { color:var(--teal); }
.los-card h3.amber { color:oklch(0.72 0.14 72); }
.los-card h3.white { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
.los-item {
  display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start;
  font-size:20px; line-height:1.4; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
.los-item .li-dot {
  width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--teal); margin-top:9px; flex-shrink:0;
}
.los-item .li-dot.amber { background:oklch(0.72 0.14 72); }
.los-bottom {
  margin-top:20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  border-radius:12px; padding:20px 28px; font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.5; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  border-top:none; flex:1;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;
}
.los-bottom strong { color:oklch(0.72 0.13 196); }

.skim-mini {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
  gap:3px; margin-top:auto; margin-bottom:0;
}
.sk-cell {
  aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:3px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px; font-family:var(--mono); font-weight:500;
  color:#fff;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 8 — INIT TOURS
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s8 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:60px; }
.s8 .left  { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.s8 .right { width:600px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; justify-content:center; }
.tour-type {
  background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:24px 28px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  display:flex; gap:18px; align-items:flex-start;
}
.tour-type .tt-icon {
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:10px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  flex-shrink:0; font-size:20px; font-weight:700;
}
.tour-type .tt-icon.teal { background:var(--teal-lt); color:var(--teal); }
.tour-type .tt-icon.amber { background:var(--amber-lt); color:var(--amber); }
.tour-type .tt-icon.navy { background:var(--navy); color:#fff; }
.tour-type h4 { font-size:22px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:4px; }
.tour-type p  { font-size:19px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.4; }
.s8 .body-text { font-size:25px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:24px; }
.s8 .body-text strong { color:var(--navy); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 9 — INPUT CHECKER
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s9 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:60px; }
.s9 .left  { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.s9 .right { width:640px; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.s9 .body-text { font-size:25px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:24px; }
.s9 .body-text strong { color:var(--navy); }
.checker-list { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; margin-bottom:28px; }
.checker-item {
  display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start;
  font-size:22px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--muted);
}
.checker-item .ci-num {
  width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff;
  font-size:14px; font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  margin-top:2px;
}
.flow-diagram {
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; width:100%;
}
.fd-box {
  padding:18px 24px; border-radius:12px;
  font-size:20px; font-weight:600; text-align:center;
  border:2px solid;
}
.fd-box.input  { background:var(--teal-lt); border-color:var(--teal); color:var(--navy); }
.fd-box.check  { background:var(--navy); border-color:var(--navy); color:#fff; }
.fd-box.pass   { background:#e8f5e9; border-color:#4caf50; color:#1b5e20; }
.fd-box.fail   { background:#fce4e4; border-color:#e53935; color:#b71c1c; }
.fd-arrow {
  text-align:center; font-size:24px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1;
}
.fd-split { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 10 — ACCESSIBILITY CONCEPT
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s10 {
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  padding:72px 120px; justify-content:center;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.s10::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; right:-80px; top:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:600px; height:600px; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle, oklch(0.45 0.12 196/0.3) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.s10 .big-def {
  font-size:44px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4;
  max-width:940px; color:#fff; margin-bottom:48px;
}
.s10 .big-def em { color:oklch(0.72 0.13 196); font-style:normal; }
.concept-pills { display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:40px; }
.concept-pill {
  padding:10px 22px; border-radius:100px;
  font-size:20px; font-weight:500;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
}
.concept-pill.active {
  border-color:var(--teal); color:var(--teal);
  background:oklch(0.3 0.1 196/0.25);
}
.s10 .vs-note {
  font-size:24px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.45); line-height:1.6;
  max-width:760px;
}
.s10 .vs-note strong { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 11 — FORMULA
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s11 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:60px; }
.s11 .left  { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.s11 .right { width:680px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px; justify-content:center; }
.formula-box {
  background:var(--navy); border-radius:14px;
  padding:36px 40px; margin-bottom:24px;
}
.formula-box .f-label {
  font-size:16px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-bottom:18px;
}
.formula-box .f-main {
  font-family:var(--mono); font-size:28px; color:#fff;
  line-height:1.6;
}
.formula-box .f-main .fv { color:oklch(0.72 0.13 196); }
.formula-box .f-main .fk { color:oklch(0.78 0.13 72); }
.formula-parts { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; }
.formula-part {
  display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:flex-start;
  font-size:21px; line-height:1.5;
}
.fp-key {
  font-family:var(--mono); font-weight:500;
  background:var(--teal-lt); color:var(--teal);
  padding:2px 10px; border-radius:6px; flex-shrink:0;
  font-size:17px; margin-top:3px;
}
.fp-key.amber { background:var(--amber-lt); color:var(--amber); }
.fp-def { color:var(--muted); }
.decay-card {
  background:#fff; border-radius:14px; padding:24px 28px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}
.decay-card .dc-title { font-size:17px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:0.07em; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:14px; }
.decay-legend { display:flex; gap:20px; margin-top:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.dl-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:18px; color:var(--muted); }
.dl-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 12 — INPUTS & OUTPUTS
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s12 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:40px; }
.s12 .col { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.col-header {
  font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase; padding-bottom:14px;
  border-bottom:2px solid; margin-bottom:18px;
}
.col-header.teal { color:var(--teal); border-color:var(--teal); }
.col-header.amber { color:var(--amber); border-color:var(--amber); }
.io-item {
  background:#fff; border-radius:10px; padding:16px 20px;
  margin-bottom:12px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  border-left:4px solid var(--teal);
}
.io-item.amber { border-left-color:var(--amber); }
.io-item h4 { font-size:20px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:4px; }
.io-item p  { font-size:17px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.4; }
.io-item .io-tags { display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:8px; }
.io-tag {
  font-size:13px; font-weight:600; padding:2px 10px;
  border-radius:100px; background:var(--amber-lt); color:var(--amber);
}
.io-tag.teal { background:var(--teal-lt); color:var(--teal); }
.s12 .arrow-col {
  width:60px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:40px; color:var(--navy); opacity:0.2;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 13 — POSITION IN PIPELINE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s13 { display:flex; padding:72px 120px; gap:60px; }
.s13 .left  { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.s13 .right { width:540px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; justify-content:center; }

.pipeline-strip { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; }
.ps-item {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px;
  padding:12px 18px; border-radius:10px;
  font-size:19px; font-weight:500;
}
.ps-item.ps-active {
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(13,27,46,0.3);
}
.ps-item.ps-active.amber-bg {
  background:oklch(0.45 0.1 72); color:#fff;
}
.ps-item.ps-dim {
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.04); color:var(--muted);
}
.ps-dot {
  width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.4); flex-shrink:0;
}
.ps-dot.teal { background:var(--teal); }
.ps-dot.amber { background:oklch(0.72 0.14 72); }
.ps-dot.dim { background:rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }

.usage-card {
  background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:22px 26px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  border-left:4px solid var(--amber);
}
.usage-card h4 { font-size:19px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:8px; }
.usage-card ul {
  list-style:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;
}
.usage-card ul li {
  font-size:18px; color:var(--muted); padding-left:18px; position:relative;
}
.usage-card ul li::before {
  content:'→'; position:absolute; left:0; color:var(--amber); font-weight:600;
}
.s13 .body-text { font-size:25px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:24px; }
.s13 .body-text strong { color:var(--navy); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE 14 — TAKEAWAYS
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.s14 {
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:72px 120px;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.s14::after {
  content:''; position:absolute; right:-100px; bottom:-100px;
  width:500px; height:500px; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle, oklch(0.45 0.12 196/0.3) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.s14 .slide-title { margin-bottom:36px; }

.ta-item {
  display:flex; gap:24px; align-items:flex-start;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-radius:14px; padding:28px 32px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
}
.ta-num {
  font-size:40px; font-weight:700; line-height:1;
  color:var(--teal); opacity:0.5; flex-shrink:0;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.ta-item h4 { font-size:26px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-bottom:6px; }
.ta-item p  { font-size:21px; line-height:1.5; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }

/* Bridge card layout for slide 14 */
.s14-bridge-grid {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:24px; flex:1;
  align-items:stretch;
}
.s14-bridge-card {
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius:16px; padding:28px 28px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;
}
.s14-bc-num {
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:22px; font-weight:800; color:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
}
.s14-bc-head {
  font-size:26px; font-weight:700; color:#fff;
}
.s14-bc-body {
  font-size:19px; line-height:1.55; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); flex:1;
}
.s14-bc-body code {
  font-family:var(--mono); font-size:16px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px;
  color:oklch(0.72 0.13 196);
}
.s14-bc-tag {
  font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.05em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); text-transform:uppercase; padding-top:8px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}
.s14-bridge-cta {
  margin-top:16px; text-align:center;
  font-size:22px; font-weight:600; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  font-style:italic;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDES 15-19 — NEW ACCESSIBILITY DEEP DIVE
   Color palette: coral (#e8503a) + forest (#1d5c3e) + off-white
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root {
  --coral:      #e8503a;
  --coral-lt:   #fdf0ee;
  --coral-dk:   #b83424;
  --forest:     #1d5c3e;
  --forest-lt:  #e8f5ee;
  --forest-dk:  #134030;
  --gold:       #c9930a;
  --gold-lt:    #fdf6e3;
  --slate:      #2c3e50;
  --slate-lt:   #ecf0f1;
}

/* ─── SLIDE 15 — WHAT NUMBER GETS USED ─── */
.s15 {
  background: var(--off-white);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 56px 100px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.s15::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; right:-80px; top:-80px;
  width:400px; height:400px; border-radius:50%;

}

  color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:10px;
}

  font-size:58px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.08; color:var(--navy);
  margin-bottom:14px;
}

  font-size:22px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--muted); max-width:1600px;

}

  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 64px 1fr; gap:0;
  flex:1; align-items:stretch;
}
.s15-col {
  border-radius:16px; padding:32px 36px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;
}
.s15-col.tdm { background:#fff; box-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

}

}

}

.s15-vs {
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:24px; font-weight:800; color:var(--muted);
  opacity:0.4;
}
.s15-question {
  margin-top:20px; text-align:center;
  font-size:26px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--coral-lt), var(--forest-lt));
  border-radius:12px; padding:18px 32px;
}

/* ─── SLIDE 16 — SALT LAKE CITY / AD HOC ─── */
.s16 {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:60px;
  padding:60px 100px; background:var(--off-white); position:relative;
}
.s16-eyebrow {
  font-size:17px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em;

}
.s16-formula-label { font-size:15px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }

.s16-formula-sub { font-size:16px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-style:italic; }
.s16-sliders {
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;

}
.s16-slider-row {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 160px 52px;
  align-items:center; gap:12px;
}
.s16-slider-row label { font-size:18px; font-weight:600; color:var(--slate); }
.s16-slider-row input[type=range] {
  width:100%; accent-color:var(--coral);

}
.s16-slider-row span {
  font-size:19px; font-weight:700; color:var(--coral);
  font-family:var(--mono); text-align:right;
}
.s16-flow { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0; align-items:stretch; }
.s16-box {
  border-radius:14px; padding:20px 24px;
```
