<!-- ════════ SLIDE 13 — POSITION IN PIPELINE ════════ -->
<section class="s13" data-label="Accessibility in the Model Sequence">
  <div class="left">
    <div class="eyebrow amber an fi d0">Why Position Matters</div>
    <div class="slide-title an fu d1" style="font-size:60px;">Where Accessibility Fits</div>
    <p class="body-text an fu d2">
      Accessibility runs <strong>immediately after land use is loaded</strong> — before any person or household data. This is intentional: it is an <strong>aggregate, zone-level calculation</strong> that needs only skims and employment.
    </p>
    <p class="body-text an fu d3">
      Once computed, the 10 accessibility measures are attached to the land use table and become available to every behavioral model as zone-level explanatory variables.
    </p>
    <div class="usage-card an fu d4">
      <h4>Used Downstream In:</h4>
      <ul>
        <li>School location choice — transit access to schools</li>
        <li>Work location choice — auto &amp; transit access to employment</li>
        <li>Non-mandatory destination choice — retail accessibility</li>
        <li>Mode choice — relative accessibility by mode</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="right">
    <div style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:14px;" class="an fi d2">Pipeline Sequence</div>
    <div class="pipeline-strip">
      <div class="ps-item ps-dim an fu d2"><div class="ps-dot dim"></div>input_checker</div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-active an fu d3"><div class="ps-dot teal"></div>initialize_landuse</div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-active amber-bg an fu d4"><div class="ps-dot" style="background:#fff;"></div>compute_accessibility ← runs here</div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-active an fu d5"><div class="ps-dot teal"></div>initialize_households</div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-dim an fu d6"><div class="ps-dot dim"></div>initialize_los &amp; initialize_tvpb</div>
      <div style="border-left:2px dashed var(--border); margin-left:20px; padding:8px 0 8px 20px;" class="an fi d7">
        <div style="font-size:18px; color:var(--muted); font-style:italic;">accessibility table now available...</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-dim an fu d7"><div class="ps-dot dim"></div>school_location_choice ↖ uses it</div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-dim an fu d8"><div class="ps-dot dim"></div>work_location_choice ↖ uses it</div>
      <div class="ps-item ps-dim an fu d8"><div class="ps-dot dim"></div>destination_choice ↖ uses it</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════════ SLIDE 14 — BRIDGE: ACCESSIBILITY TYPES ════════ -->
<section class="s14" data-label="Three Types of Accessibility Measures">
  <div class="eyebrow amber an fi d0">Going Deeper</div>
  <div class="slide-title white an fu d1">Three Types of Accessibility Measures</div>
  <div class="s14-bridge-grid">
    <div class="s14-bridge-card an fu d2">
      <div class="s14-bc-num" style="background:oklch(0.60 0.13 196);">A</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-head">Aggregate</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-body">Pre-computed per zone. The log-sum-of-employment formula from <code>compute_accessibility</code>. One value per TAZ, per mode, per period. Feeds auto ownership, work location, free parking.</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-tag">Zone-level · Fast · Already in ActivitySim</div>
    </div>
    <div class="s14-bridge-card an fu d3">
      <div class="s14-bc-num" style="background:var(--amber);">D</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-head">Disaggregate</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-body">Computed per person using mode-choice logsums. Theoretically consistent — cost and time both included. Captures who you are, not just where you live.</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-tag">Person-level · Consistent · Expensive to retrofit</div>
    </div>
    <div class="s14-bridge-card an fu d4">
      <div class="s14-bc-num" style="background:#e8503a;">H</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-head">Ad Hoc</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-body">Convenience measures chosen for predictive fit: drive-time savings, raw auto IVT, etc. Works well for routine scenarios — breaks on novel policies that change time and cost in opposite directions.</div>
      <div class="s14-bc-tag">Shortcut · Often predicts better · Inconsistency risk</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s14-bridge-cta an fu d5">→ The next slides explore what happens when these measures disagree — and why it matters for policy analysis</div>
</section>

<!-- ════════ SLIDE 15 — WHAT NUMBER GETS USED? ════════ -->
<section class="s15" data-label="What Number Gets Used?">
  <div class="s15-eyebrow an fi d0">The Core Question</div>
  <div class="s15-title an fu d1">What Number Gets Used?</div>
  <p class="s15-intro an fu d2">When a person in the model decides to own a car or choose a job location — what does the model use to represent "how easy is it to get around from here?" That number is the <strong>accessibility measure</strong>, and the choice matters enormously for novel policies.</p>
  <div class="s15-grid">
    <div class="s15-col tdm an fu d3">
      <div class="s15-col-head tdm-head">4-Step TDM</div>
      <div class="s15-measure-box">
        <div class="s15-measure-label">Trip Distribution</div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip tdm-chip">Drive time (impedance)</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s15-measure-box">
        <div class="s15-measure-label">Auto Ownership</div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip tdm-chip">Time savings vs. transit</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s15-measure-box">
        <div class="s15-measure-label">Mode Choice</div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip tdm-chip">IVT + wait time</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s15-note tdm-note">⚠ Each submodel picks its own shortcut — "ad hoc" measures chosen for fit, not consistency</div>
    </div>
    <div class="s15-vs an si d4">VS</div>
    <div class="s15-col abm an fu d5">
      <div class="s15-col-head abm-head">ActivitySim (ABM)</div>
      <div class="s15-measure-box">
        <div class="s15-measure-label">Auto Ownership</div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip abm-chip-a">Aggregate accessibility <em>or</em></div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip abm-chip-b">Disaggregate logsum ✓</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s15-measure-box">
        <div class="s15-measure-label">Work Location Choice</div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip abm-chip-a">Zone accessibility <em>or</em></div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip abm-chip-b">Destination logsum ✓</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s15-measure-box">
        <div class="s15-measure-label">Destination Choice</div>
        <div class="s15-measure-chip abm-chip-b">Mode choice logsum ✓</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s15-note abm-note">✓ One consistent spec — all submodels respond to the same policy signal</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s15-question an fu d6">Does every part of your model respond <em>consistently</em> to the same policy change?</div>
</section>

<!-- ════════ SLIDE 16 — SALT LAKE CITY / AD HOC PROBLEM ════════ -->
<section class="s16" data-label="The Ad Hoc Problem: Salt Lake City">
  <div class="s16-left">
    <div class="s16-eyebrow an fi d0">Ad Hoc Accessibility</div>
    <div class="s16-title an fu d1">The Salt Lake City Problem</div>
    <p class="s16-scenario an fu d2"><strong>Scenario:</strong> WFRC tests a downtown cordon toll. Driving into downtown becomes <span class="s16-fast">faster</span> (less congestion) but costs <span class="s16-costly">more money</span>.</p>

    <div class="s16-formula an fu d3">
      <div class="s16-formula-label">WFRC auto ownership uses this ad hoc measure:</div>
      <div class="s16-formula-math">Accessibility = Auto time savings vs. transit</div>
      <div class="s16-formula-sub">(minutes saved by driving — cost never appears)</div>
    </div>

    <div class="s16-sliders an fu d4">
      <div class="s16-slider-row">
        <label>🚗 Toll cost increase</label>
        <input type="range" id="tollCost" min="0" max="10" value="0" step="0.5">
        <span id="tollCostVal">$0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="s16-slider-row">
        <label>⏱ Time saving (min)</label>
        <input type="range" id="timeSaving" min="0" max="15" value="0" step="1">
        <span id="timeSavingVal">0 min</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="s16-right">
    <div class="s16-flow an fu d3">
      <div class="s16-box s16-box-policy">
        <div class="s16-box-icon">🏙️</div>
        <div class="s16-box-title">Cordon Toll Introduced</div>
        <div class="s16-box-body" id="flowPolicyText">Set the sliders →</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s16-arrow">↓</div>
      <div class="s16-box s16-box-model" id="flowModelBox">
        <div class="s16-box-icon">👁️</div>
        <div class="s16-box-title">Ad Hoc Model Sees…</div>
        <div class="s16-box-body" id="flowModelText">Adjust toll & time saving</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s16-arrow">↓</div>
      <div class="s16-box s16-box-result" id="flowResultBox">
        <div class="s16-box-icon" id="flowResultIcon">🤔</div>
        <div class="s16-box-title">Model Predicts…</div>
        <div class="s16-box-body" id="flowResultText">Waiting for input</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="s16-verdict" id="flowVerdict"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════════ SLIDE 17 — DISAGGREGATE / LOGSUM ════════ -->
<section class="s17" data-label="Disaggregate Accessibility: The Logsum">
  <div class="s17-left">
    <div class="s17-eyebrow an fi d0">The Consistent Alternative</div>
    <div class="s17-title an fu d1">Disaggregate Accessibility</div>
    <div class="s17-formula-block an fu d2">
      <div class="s17-formula-label">The Logsum — expected best option across ALL modes</div>
      <div class="s17-formula">Logsum = ln [ exp(V<sub>auto</sub>) + exp(V<sub>transit</sub>) + exp(V<sub>walk</sub>) ]</div>
      <div class="s17-formula-sub">where V<sub>auto</sub> = β<sub>time</sub> × travel_time + β<sub>cost</sub> × travel_cost</div>
      <div class="s17-formula-note">Same spec as your mode choice model — cost is <em>already in it</em></div>
    </div>
    <div class="s17-insights">
      <div class="s17-insight an fu d3">
        <div class="s17-insight-num">1</div>
        <div><strong>Time AND cost are both included</strong><br>Your mode choice model already has both. The logsum inherits everything — time, cost, transfers, parking.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s17-insight an fu d4">
        <div class="s17-insight-num">2</div>
        <div><strong>Computed per person, not per zone</strong><br>Person A near transit ≠ Person B in a car-dependent suburb, even in the same zone. That's "disaggregate."</div>
      </div>
      <div class="s17-insight an fu d5">
        <div class="s17-insight-num">3</div>
        <div><strong>Add a toll → logsum falls → car ownership falls</strong><br>V<sub>auto</sub> drops → logsum drops → auto ownership model responds correctly. All components stay in sync.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s17-right">
    <div class="s17-demo an si d3">
      <div class="s17-demo-title">Logsum Calculator</div>
      <div class="s17-demo-sub">Adjust parameters — watch how the logsum responds</div>
      <div class="s17-demo-inputs">
        <div class="s17-inp-row">
          <label>Auto travel time (min)</label>
          <input type="range" id="autoTime" min="5" max="60" value="20" step="1">
          <span id="autoTimeVal">20</span>
        </div>
        <div class="s17-inp-row">
          <label>Auto cost ($)</label>
          <input type="range" id="autoCost" min="0" max="15" value="0" step="0.5">
          <span id="autoCostVal">$0</span>
        </div>
        <div class="s17-inp-row">
          <label>Transit time (min)</label>
          <input type="range" id="transitTime" min="10" max="80" value="35" step="1">
          <span id="transitTimeVal">35</span>
        </div>
        <div class="s17-inp-row s17-toll-row" id="tollRow">
          <label>🚧 Cordon toll ($)</label>
          <input type="range" id="tollAmt" min="0" max="10" value="0" step="0.5">
          <span id="tollAmtVal">$0</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s17-results">
        <div class="s17-result-item">
          <div class="s17-result-label">V<sub>auto</sub></div>
          <div class="s17-result-val" id="vAutoVal">—</div>
        </div>
        <div class="s17-result-item">
          <div class="s17-result-label">V<sub>transit</sub></div>
          <div class="s17-result-val" id="vTransitVal">—</div>
        </div>
        <div class="s17-result-item s17-result-logsum">
          <div class="s17-result-label">Logsum</div>
          <div class="s17-result-val" id="logsumVal">—</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s17-interpretation" id="s17Interp"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="s17-strategies">
      <div class="s17-strategy s17-strat-a an fu d5">
        <div class="s17-strat-head">Strategy A — Build it in</div>
        <p>Include cost in accessibility during model development. Novel policies handled automatically. Higher upfront investment, lower application risk.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="s17-strategy s17-strat-b an fu d6">
        <div class="s17-strat-head">Strategy B — Intervene at application</div>
        <p>Keep ad hoc measures but convert tolls to time-equivalents manually. Lower upfront cost, requires expert judgment at application time.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════════ SLIDE 18 — HONEST TRADEOFFS ════════ -->
<section class="s18" data-label="Honest Tradeoffs">
  <div class="s18-eyebrow an fi d0">The Full Picture</div>
  <div class="s18-title an fu d1">Disaggregate Accessibility: Honest Tradeoffs</div>
  <div class="s18-cols">
    <div class="s18-col s18-pros an fu d2">
      <div class="s18-col-head pros-head">✓ Pros</div>
      <div class="s18-pro-item an fu d3">
        <div class="s18-pi-icon">⚙️</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-pi-title">Consistent responses</div>
          <p>A toll affects auto ownership, mode choice, and destination choice — all correctly, all from one spec. No component out of sync.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s18-pro-item an fu d4">
        <div class="s18-pi-icon">📈</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-pi-title">Improves automatically</div>
          <p>As your mode choice spec improves, accessibility improves too. No extra calibration work.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s18-pro-item an fu d5">
        <div class="s18-pi-icon">💰</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-pi-title">Consumer surplus measure</div>
          <p>Change in logsums = a rigorous benefit-cost measure. Peer reviewers and funding agencies respond well.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s18-pro-item an fu d6">
        <div class="s18-pi-icon">🎓</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-pi-title">Theoretically sound</div>
          <p>Derived from utility maximization theory. Defensible in academic and regulatory review.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="s18-divider"></div>
    <div class="s18-col s18-cons an fu d2">
      <div class="s18-col-head cons-head">✗ Cons</div>
      <div class="s18-con-item an fu d3">
        <div class="s18-ci-icon">🐢</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-ci-title">Computationally expensive</div>
          <p>Computed per person, not per zone. Adds significant runtime on large models.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s18-con-item an fu d4">
        <div class="s18-ci-icon">🔧</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-ci-title">Retrofitting is painful</div>
          <p>Adding the step is only half the job. You must also update every submodel using ad hoc measures — expensive and tedious.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s18-con-item s18-highlight an fu d5">
        <div class="s18-ci-icon">⚠️</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-ci-title">Ad hoc often predicts better!</div>
          <p>Time savings may simply be more predictive of car ownership than the logsum. Theoretical consistency ≠ better fit.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="s18-con-item an fu d6">
        <div class="s18-ci-icon">🔍</div>
        <div>
          <div class="s18-ci-title">Harder to debug</div>
          <p>When submodels are tightly coupled through logsums, tracing unexpected results becomes more difficult.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s18-verdict an fu d7">Both strategies are legitimate. Build-in vs. intervene depends on your policy context and team capacity.</div>
</section>

<!-- ════════ SLIDE 19 — UPDATED KEY TAKEAWAYS ════════ -->
<section class="s19" data-label="Key Takeaways">
  <div class="eyebrow amber an fi d0">Summary</div>
  <div class="slide-title white an fu d1">Key Takeaways</div>
  <div class="takeaways">
    <div class="ta-item an fu d2">
      <div class="ta-num">1</div>
      <div>
        <h4>Initialization is data pipeline setup, not behavioral modeling</h4>
        <p>The four initialize steps load, validate, and annotate inputs so downstream models have clean, consistent data. Random seeds are set here for reproducibility.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ta-item an fu d3">
      <div class="ta-num">2</div>
      <div>
        <h4>Aggregate accessibility is zone-level and pre-computed</h4>
        <p>It translates skims + employment into zonal scores (log-sum formula) consumed by auto ownership, work location, and free parking models.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ta-item an fu d4">
      <div class="ta-num">3</div>
      <div>
        <h4>Ad hoc measures create inconsistent model responses to novel policies</h4>
        <p>If cost is missing from your accessibility term, a cordon toll can wrongly predict <em>more</em> car ownership — because the model only sees the time saving.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ta-item an fu d5">
      <div class="ta-num">4</div>
      <div>
        <h4>Disaggregate logsums are consistent — but not always better predictors</h4>
        <p>The logsum inherits time AND cost from your mode choice spec. But ad hoc measures often fit observed data better. Both Strategy A (build in) and B (intervene) are defensible.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

</deck-stage>

<script>
// ── Animation restart on slide change ──
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const stage = document.querySelector('deck-stage');

  stage.addEventListener('slidechange', (e) => {
    const slide = e.detail.slide;
    if (!slide) return;
    // Restart stagger animations by forcing reflow
    const els = slide.querySelectorAll('.an');
    els.forEach(el => {
      el.style.animation = 'none';
      void el.offsetWidth;
      el.style.animation = '';
    });
    // Slide-specific JS
    const label = slide.dataset.label;
    if (label === 'Step 3 — Initialize LOS') buildSkimGrid();
    if (label === 'The Accessibility Calculation') drawDecay();
    if (label === 'The Ad Hoc Problem: Salt Lake City') initSLC();
    if (label === 'Disaggregate Accessibility: The Logsum') initLogsum();
  });

  // Also run on init
  stage.addEventListener('slidechange', (e) => {
    if (e.detail.index === 0) return;
  }, { once: true });
});

// ── Skim grid visual (slide 7) ──
function buildSkimGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('skim-grid');
  if (!grid || grid.dataset.built) return;
  grid.dataset.built = '1';
  const n = 5;
  const vals = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n*n; i++) {
    const r = Math.floor(i/n), c = i%n;
    const t = r === c ? 0 : Math.round(5 + Math.random()*55);
    vals.push(t);
  }
  const max = Math.max(...vals);
  vals.forEach((v, i) => {
    const cell = document.createElement('div');
    cell.className = 'sk-cell';
    const intensity = v === 0 ? 0 : v / max;
    const r = Math.floor(i/n), c = i%n;
    let bg;
    if (r === c) bg = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    else bg = `oklch(${0.65 - intensity*0.3} ${0.05 + intensity*0.1} 196)`;
    cell.style.background = bg;
    cell.style.opacity = v === 0 ? '0.3' : '1';
    cell.textContent = v === 0 ? '—' : v;
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  });
}

// ── Decay curve (slide 11) ──
function drawDecay() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('decayCanvas');
  if (!canvas || canvas.dataset.drawn) return;
  canvas.dataset.drawn = '1';

  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const pad = { t: 20, r: 20, b: 40, l: 50 };
  const pw = W - pad.l - pad.r;
  const ph = H - pad.t - pad.b;

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Axes
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pad.l, pad.t); ctx.lineTo(pad.l, pad.t + ph);
  ctx.lineTo(pad.l + pw, pad.t + ph);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Axis labels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8899aa'; ctx.font = '13px DM Sans, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Travel Time (minutes)', pad.l + pw/2, H - 4);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(14, pad.t + ph/2);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);
  ctx.fillText('e^(−β·t)', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();

  // X ticks
  [0,20,40,60,80].forEach(v => {
    const x = pad.l + (v/80)*pw;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8899aa'; ctx.font = '12px DM Sans, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(v, x, pad.t + ph + 18);
  });

  const modes = [
    { beta: 0.025, color: 'oklch(0.60 0.13 196)', label: 'Auto', lw: 2.5 },
    { beta: 0.045, color: 'oklch(0.68 0.14 72)',  label: 'Transit', lw: 2.5 },
    { beta: 0.10,  color: '#8899aa',              label: 'Walk', lw: 2.5 },
  ];

  const maxT = 80;

  modes.forEach(mode => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = mode.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = mode.lw;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    for (let px = 0; px <= pw; px++) {
      const t = (px / pw) * maxT;
      const y = Math.exp(-mode.beta * t);
      const cx2 = pad.l + px;
      const cy2 = pad.t + ph - y * ph;
      if (px === 0) ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy2);
      else ctx.lineTo(cx2, cy2);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  // Animate the draw with a clip rect sweep
  let pct = 0;
  canvas.dataset.drawn = '1';
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  function frame() {
    pct = Math.min(pct + 0.025, 1);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pad.l, pad.t); ctx.lineTo(pad.l, pad.t + ph);
    ctx.lineTo(pad.l + pw, pad.t + ph);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8899aa'; ctx.font = '13px "DM Sans", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Travel Time (minutes)', pad.l + pw/2, H - 4);
    [0,20,40,60,80].forEach(v => {
      const x = pad.l + (v/80)*pw;
      ctx.fillText(v, x, pad.t + ph + 18);
    });

    const clipW = pw * pct;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(pad.l, 0, clipW, H);
    ctx.clip();

    modes.forEach(mode => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = mode.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = mode.lw;
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      for (let px2 = 0; px2 <= pw; px2++) {
        const t = (px2 / pw) * maxT;
        const y = Math.exp(-mode.beta * t);
        const cx2 = pad.l + px2;
        const cy2 = pad.t + ph - y * ph * 0.9 - pad.t * 0.1;
        if (px2 === 0) ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy2);
        else ctx.lineTo(cx2, cy2);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    });

    ctx.restore();
    if (pct < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  frame();
}

// Initialize any visible slide on first load
setTimeout(() => {
  const active = document.querySelector('[data-deck-active]');
  if (active) {
    const label = active.dataset.label;
    if (label === 'Step 3 — Initialize LOS') buildSkimGrid();
    if (label === 'The Accessibility Calculation') drawDecay();
    if (label === 'The Ad Hoc Problem: Salt Lake City') initSLC();
    if (label === 'Disaggregate Accessibility: The Logsum') initLogsum();
  }
}, 400);

// ── SLIDE 16: Salt Lake City Ad Hoc Simulator ──
function initSLC() {
  const costSlider   = document.getElementById('tollCost');
  const timeSlider   = document.getElementById('timeSaving');
  const costVal      = document.getElementById('tollCostVal');
  const timeVal      = document.getElementById('timeSavingVal');
  const policyText   = document.getElementById('flowPolicyText');
  const modelText    = document.getElementById('flowModelText');
  const resultText   = document.getElementById('flowResultText');
  const resultIcon   = document.getElementById('flowResultIcon');
  const resultBox    = document.getElementById('flowResultBox');
  const modelBox     = document.getElementById('flowModelBox');
  const verdict      = document.getElementById('flowVerdict');

  if (!costSlider || costSlider.dataset.slcInit) return;
  costSlider.dataset.slcInit = '1';

  function update() {
    const cost = parseFloat(costSlider.value);
    const time = parseFloat(timeSlider.value);

    costVal.textContent = '$' + cost.toFixed(1);
    timeVal.textContent = time + ' min';

    // Policy box
    if (cost === 0 && time === 0) {
      policyText.textContent = 'Set the sliders to simulate the cordon toll →';
      modelText.textContent  = 'Adjust toll & time saving above';
      resultText.textContent = 'Waiting for input';
      resultIcon.textContent = '🤔';
      resultBox.style.background = '#fff';
      resultBox.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
      modelBox.style.borderColor  = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
      verdict.textContent = '';
      verdict.className = 's16-verdict';
      return;
    }

    policyText.innerHTML =
      (cost > 0 ? `<span style="color:#e8503a;font-weight:700;">+$${cost.toFixed(1)} toll cost</span>` : '') +
      (cost > 0 && time > 0 ? ' · ' : '') +
      (time > 0 ? `<span style="color:#1d5c3e;font-weight:700;">${time} min faster</span>` : '');

    // What the ad hoc model sees — ONLY time saving
    if (time === 0) {
      modelText.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#5a6e80;">No time saving detected — no change</span>';
      modelBox.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';
    } else {
      modelText.innerHTML = `<strong style="color:#1d5c3e;">${time} min time saving ✓</strong><br><span style="color:#e8503a;font-size:15px;">$${cost.toFixed(1)} toll cost — invisible to model ✗</span>`;
      modelBox.style.borderColor = '#1d5c3e';
    }

    // Model prediction
    if (time > 0 && cost > 0) {
      // This is the inconsistent scenario
      const severity = cost >= 5 ? 'large' : 'small';
      resultIcon.textContent = '📈';
      resultText.innerHTML = `Predicts <strong>more car ownership</strong>!<br><small style="font-weight:400;font-size:15px;">(Saw ${time}min saving, ignored $${cost.toFixed(1)} cost)</small>`;
      resultBox.style.background = '#fdf0ee';
      resultBox.style.borderColor = '#e8503a';
      verdict.textContent = '⚠ WRONG — a cordon toll should discourage car ownership, not increase it!';
      verdict.className = 's16-verdict wrong';
    } else if (time > 0 && cost === 0) {
      resultIcon.textContent = '📈';
      resultText.innerHTML = `Predicts <strong>more car ownership</strong><br><small style="font-weight:400;font-size:15px;">(Time saving with no cost = consistent result)</small>`;
      resultBox.style.background = '#e8f5ee';
      resultBox.style.borderColor = '#1d5c3e';
      verdict.textContent = '✓ Consistent — time saving only, no cost trade-off, model responds correctly.';
      verdict.className = 's16-verdict ok';
    } else {
      // cost > 0, time = 0
      resultIcon.textContent = '➡️';
      resultText.innerHTML = `<strong>No change predicted</strong><br><small style="font-weight:400;font-size:15px;">(Cost invisible — model unchanged)</small>`;
      resultBox.style.background = '#ecf0f1';
      resultBox.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
      verdict.textContent = '⚠ Silent failure — toll costs real money but the model ignores it entirely.';
      verdict.className = 's16-verdict neutral';
    }
  }

  costSlider.addEventListener('input', update);
  timeSlider.addEventListener('input', update);
  update();
}

// ── SLIDE 17: Logsum Interactive Calculator ──
function initLogsum() {
  const autoTimeSlider    = document.getElementById('autoTime');
  const autoCostSlider    = document.getElementById('autoCost');
  const transitTimeSlider = document.getElementById('transitTime');
  const tollSlider        = document.getElementById('tollAmt');

  const autoTimeVal    = document.getElementById('autoTimeVal');
  const autoCostVal    = document.getElementById('autoCostVal');
  const transitTimeVal = document.getElementById('transitTimeVal');
  const tollAmtVal     = document.getElementById('tollAmtVal');

  const vAutoEl    = document.getElementById('vAutoVal');
  const vTransitEl = document.getElementById('vTransitVal');
  const logsumEl   = document.getElementById('logsumVal');
  const interpEl   = document.getElementById('s17Interp');

  if (!autoTimeSlider || autoTimeSlider.dataset.lsInit) return;
  autoTimeSlider.dataset.lsInit = '1';

  // Coefficients (typical mode choice model values)
  const B_TIME  = -0.025;   // per minute
  const B_COST  = -0.18;    // per dollar
  const V_WALK  = -2.2;     // fixed walk utility (short trips only)

  function update() {
    const autoTime    = parseFloat(autoTimeSlider.value);
    const autoCost    = parseFloat(autoCostSlider.value);
    const transitTime = parseFloat(transitTimeSlider.value);
    const toll        = parseFloat(tollSlider.value);
    const totalAutoCost = autoCost + toll;

    autoTimeVal.textContent    = autoTime;
    autoCostVal.textContent    = '$' + autoCost.toFixed(1);
    transitTimeVal.textContent = transitTime;
    tollAmtVal.textContent     = '$' + toll.toFixed(1);

    const vAuto    = B_TIME * autoTime    + B_COST * totalAutoCost;
    const vTransit = B_TIME * transitTime + B_COST * 1.50;  // fixed $1.50 fare
    const vWalk    = V_WALK;

    const logsum = Math.log(Math.exp(vAuto) + Math.exp(vTransit) + Math.exp(vWalk));

    vAutoEl.textContent    = vAuto.toFixed(3);
    vTransitEl.textContent = vTransit.toFixed(3);
    logsumEl.textContent   = logsum.toFixed(3);

    // Color feedback on V_auto
    vAutoEl.style.color = vAuto < vTransit ? '#e8503a' : '#1d5c3e';

    // Interpretation
    let msg = '';
    if (toll > 0) {
      const logsumNoToll = Math.log(
        Math.exp(B_TIME * autoTime + B_COST * autoCost) +
        Math.exp(vTransit) + Math.exp(vWalk)
      );
      const drop = logsumNoToll - logsum;
      msg = `🚧 Toll of $${toll.toFixed(1)} reduces logsum by <strong>${drop.toFixed(3)}</strong>. `
          + `V_auto drops → logsum drops → auto ownership model responds correctly. `
          + (toll >= 3 ? '<span style="color:#e8503a;font-weight:700;">Significant deterrent effect.</span>' : 'Modest deterrent.');
    } else if (autoTime < transitTime * 0.6) {
      msg = '🚗 Auto is much faster — V_auto dominates the logsum. High auto accessibility.';
    } else if (vTransit > vAuto) {
      msg = '🚌 Transit is more attractive here — logsum is transit-driven. Good transit zone.';
    } else {
      msg = 'Adjust sliders to see how time, cost, and tolls shift the logsum.';
    }
    interpEl.innerHTML = msg;
  }

  autoTimeSlider.addEventListener('input', update);
  autoCostSlider.addEventListener('input', update);
  transitTimeSlider.addEventListener('input', update);
  tollSlider.addEventListener('input', update);
  update();
}
</script>
